description:
Zensus 2022 building data for Berlin. Source: Statistisches Bundesamt, Zensus 2022.

Without a category: total number of buildings.
With a category:
- bauweise: construction type (detached, row house, semi-detached)
- eigentumsform: ownership type (private individual, cooperative, municipality)
- heizungsart: heating type (central heating, per-floor heating, individual stoves)
- energietraeger: energy source (gas, oil, district heating, electricity)

Parameters:
- rbs: "stadt" (city) | "bezirk" (Borough) | "stadtteil" | "ortsteil" (District) | "planungsraum" (Neighborhood, LOR Planungsraum)
- kategorie: "bauweise" | "eigentumsform" | "heizungsart" | "energietraeger" (optional)
- bezirk_id, stadtteil_id, ortsteil_id, planungsraum_id: geographic filters
- start/end, recent, limit, fields, include: "metadata"
name: socio_berlin_census_buildings
title: Census Buildings
